title: Mirantis Analisi Pod
description: Root cause analysis di un pod: stato, risorse, restart/probe e correlazione con salute e pressure del nodo ospitante.

options.content:
**Come si usa:** scegli namespace → nodo → workload → pod. Il filtro Nodo restringe workload e pod a quelli presenti su quel nodo nel periodo.

**1. Tabella "Filtro nodo".** Riga tutta verde → il nodo era sano: la causa è nel **pod** (limiti, probe, applicazione, dipendenze). Rossi → verifica prima il **nodo** e guarda se il momento coincide nella *Timeline di correlazione*.

**2. Indizi tipici**
- `OOMKilled` + memoria vicina al limit → limit troppo basso o leak.
- `OOMKilled` / exit 137 con memoria **lontana** dal limit → OOM del **nodo** (MemoryPressure, vicini rumorosi).
- Exit 137 senza OOM + *Probe fallite* → kill da liveness probe.
- Throttling alto → CPU limit troppo basso, con latenze e timeout.
- Pod NotReady con nodo sano e senza restart → readiness probe o dipendenza esterna.
- Eviction sul nodo → pressure (disco/memoria) sul nodo, non l'app.

Exit code: 137 = SIGKILL · 143 = SIGTERM · 1 = errore applicativo · 0 = uscita pulita.

panels.title: Pod NotReady ora (no Job)
panels.description: Esclusi i pod dei Job/CronJob (a fine esecuzione risultano sempre NotReady).

targets.expr: count(max by(pod) (kube_pod_status_ready{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", condition="false"} == 1) unless on(pod) max by(pod) (max_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", owner_kind="Job"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)
round(sum(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: OOMKilled
panels.description: Container il cui ultimo stop è stato OOMKilled.

targets.expr: count(kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", reason="OOMKilled"} == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Probe KO
panels.description: Probe fallite nel periodo (prober_probe_total del kubelet).

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(prober_probe_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", result="failed"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

max(max_over_time((100 * max by(pod,container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="", image!=""}) / max by(pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", resource="memory"}))[$__range:1m]))

max(max_over_time((100 * sum by(pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!=""}[5m])) / sum by(pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!=""}[5m])))[$__range:1m]))

panels.title: Waiting
panels.description: Container passati per CrashLoopBackOff / ImagePull / ConfigError nel periodo.

targets.expr: count(max by(pod,container) (max_over_time((kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", reason!="ContainerCreating"} == 1)[$__range:]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Stato nodi ospitanti
panels.description: Tutto verde = il nodo non spiega il problema del pod. Tempo NotReady breve e su tutti i nodi insieme = flap del control plane (vedi War Room), non del nodo.

targets.expr: max by(node) ((kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="false", node=~"$node"} == 1) * 1 or (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="unknown", node=~"$node"} == 1) * 2 or (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true", node=~"$node"} == 1) * 0)

(max by(node) (count_over_time((kube_node_status_condition{node=~"$node", condition="Ready", status=~"false|unknown"} == 1)[$__range:30s]) * 30)) or on(node) (max by(node) (kube_node_info{node=~"$node"}) * 0)

(count by(node) (max by(node,condition) (max_over_time((kube_node_status_condition{node=~"$node", status="true", condition=~"MemoryPressure|DiskPressure|PIDPressure|NetworkUnavailable"} == 1)[$__range:30s])))) or on(node) (max by(node) (kube_node_info{node=~"$node"}) * 0)

(count by(node) (max by(namespace,pod,node) (max_over_time((kube_pod_status_reason{reason="Evicted"} == 1)[$__range:]) * on(namespace,pod) group_left(node) max by(namespace,pod,node) (max_over_time(kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"}[$__range:]))))) or on(node) (max by(node) (kube_node_info{node=~"$node"}) * 0)

max by(node) (max_over_time((100 * sum by(node) (
  rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", image!=""}[5m])
  * on(namespace,pod) group_left(node) max by(namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})
) / max by(node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{node=~"$node", resource="cpu"}))[$__range:1m]))
count by(node) (max by(node,pod) (max_over_time(kube_pod_info{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Classifica pod
panels.description: Una riga per pod, ordinata per tempo NotReady. I pod dei Job hanno NotReady = 0 (esclusi). Click sul nome = dashboard filtrata su quel pod.

targets.expr: (max by(pod) (count_over_time((kube_pod_status_ready{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", condition="false"} == 1)[$__range:30s]) * 30) unless on(pod) max by(pod) (max_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", owner_kind="Job"}[$__range]))) or on(pod) (max by(pod) (max_over_time(kube_pod_info{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])) * 0)

(round(sum by(pod) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])))) or on(pod) (max by(pod) (max_over_time(kube_pod_info{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])) * 0)

(round(sum by(pod) (increase(prober_probe_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", result="failed"}[$__range])))) or on(pod) (max by(pod) (max_over_time(kube_pod_info{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])) * 0)

(max by(pod) (count_over_time((max by(pod) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", reason!=""}) == 1)[$__range:30s]) * 30)) or on(pod) (max by(pod) (max_over_time(kube_pod_info{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])) * 0)

max by(pod) (max_over_time((100 * max by(pod,container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="", image!=""}) / max by(pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", resource="memory"}))[$__range:1m]))

max by(pod) (max_over_time((100 * sum by(pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!=""}[5m])) / sum by(pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!=""}[5m])))[$__range:1m]))
max by(pod,node) (max_over_time(kube_pod_info{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range]))

(max by(pod) (kube_pod_status_ready{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", condition="true"}) and on(pod) max by(pod) (max_over_time((kube_pod_status_ready{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", condition="false"} == 1)[$__range:]))) unless on(pod) max by(pod) (max_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", owner_kind="Job"}[$__range]))

(max by(pod,container) (kube_pod_container_status_running{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) * 1 + max by(pod,container) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) * 2 + max by(pod,container) (kube_pod_container_status_terminated{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) * 3) and on(pod,container) max by(pod,container) (max_over_time((kube_pod_container_status_running{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"} == 0)[$__range:]))

max by(node) ((kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="false", node=~"$node"} == 1) * 1 or (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="unknown", node=~"$node"} == 1) * 2 or (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true", node=~"$node"} == 1) * 0)

max by(node,condition) (kube_node_status_condition{node=~"$node", status="true", condition=~"MemoryPressure|DiskPressure|PIDPressure|NetworkUnavailable"}) and on(node,condition) max by(node,condition) (max_over_time((kube_node_status_condition{node=~"$node", status="true", condition=~"MemoryPressure|DiskPressure|PIDPressure|NetworkUnavailable"} == 1)[$__range:30s]))

panels.title: CPU: uso vs request vs limit (core)

targets.expr: sum by(pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval]))
max by(pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", resource="cpu"})
max by(pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", resource="cpu"})

panels.title: Memoria: working set vs request vs limit

targets.expr: max by(pod,container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="", image!=""})
max by(pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", resource="memory"})
max by(pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", resource="memory"})

panels.title: CPU throttling %
panels.description: % di periodi CFS in cui il container è stato limitato. > 25% continuativo = CPU limit stretto.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by(pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by(pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

100 * max by(pod,container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="", image!=""}) / max by(pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", resource="memory"})
sum by(pod) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))
- sum by(pod) (rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Rete pod: errori e pacchetti scartati

targets.expr: sum by(pod) (rate(container_network_receive_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(container_network_transmit_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by(pod) (rate(container_network_receive_packets_dropped_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(container_network_transmit_packets_dropped_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))
round(sum by(pod,container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range]))) > 0

panels.title: Ultima terminazione: motivo + exit code
panels.description: 137 = SIGKILL (OOM o liveness) · 143 = SIGTERM · 1 = errore applicativo.

targets.expr: max by(pod,container,reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", reason!=""} == 1)
max by(pod,container) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_exitcode{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})
round(sum by(pod,container,probe_type) (increase(prober_probe_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", result="failed"}[$__range]))) > 0
max by(pod,container,reason) (count_over_time((kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", reason!=""} == 1)[$__range:30s]) * 30)

panels.title: Restart e probe fallite nel tempo

targets.expr: sum by(pod,container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0
sum by(pod,container,probe_type) (increase(prober_probe_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", result="failed"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Nodo: CPU usata dai pod / allocatable %

targets.expr:
100 * sum by(node) (
  rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval])
  * on(namespace,pod) group_left(node) max by(namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})
) / max by(node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{node=~"$node", resource="cpu"})

panels.title: Nodo: RAM usata dai pod / allocatable %
Impegno risorse sui nodi ospitanti (ora)
panels.description: RAM limit > 100% = overcommit: se più pod crescono insieme il nodo va in MemoryPressure/OOM anche con request corrette.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by(node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"} * on(namespace,pod) group_left(node) max by(namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"}) and on(namespace,pod) max by(namespace,pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Running|Pending"} == 1)) / max by(node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{node=~"$node", resource="cpu"})

100 * sum by(node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"} * on(namespace,pod) group_left(node) max by(namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"}) and on(namespace,pod) max by(namespace,pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Running|Pending"} == 1)) / max by(node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{node=~"$node", resource="memory"})

100 * sum by(node) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory"} * on(namespace,pod) group_left(node) max by(namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"}) and on(namespace,pod) max by(namespace,pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Running|Pending"} == 1)) / max by(node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{node=~"$node", resource="memory"})
100 * count by(node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"}) / max by(node) (kube_node_status_capacity{node=~"$node", resource="pods"})

panels.title: Eviction sui nodi ospitanti nel periodo (tutti i namespace)

targets.expr: max by(namespace,pod,node) (max_over_time((kube_pod_status_reason{reason="Evicted"} == 1)[$__range:]) * on(namespace,pod) group_left(node) max by(namespace,pod,node) (max_over_time(kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"}[$__range:])))

panels.title: Altri pod sul nodo — picco CPU
panels.description: Altri pod sugli stessi nodi, escluso il pod analizzato.

targets.expr:
topk(15, max by(namespace,pod,node) (max_over_time((sum by(namespace,pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", image!=""}[5m])))[$__range:1m])
  * on(namespace,pod) group_left(node) max by(namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})
  unless on(namespace,pod) max by(namespace,pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})))

panels.title: Altri pod sul nodo — picco RAM

targets.expr:
topk(15, max by(namespace,pod,node) (max_over_time((sum by(namespace,pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", image!=""}))[$__range:1m])
  * on(namespace,pod) group_left(node) max by(namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})
  unless on(namespace,pod) max by(namespace,pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})))

panels.title: Kubelet: PLEG relist p95
panels.description: > 3s continuativo = runtime lento/bloccato (PLEG is not healthy).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(node, le) (rate(kubelet_pleg_relist_duration_seconds_bucket{node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))
sum by(node,operation_type) (rate(kubelet_runtime_operations_errors_total{node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: PSI memoria: % tempo in stallo
panels.description: Pressure Stall Information del kernel: tempo in cui i processi aspettano memoria.

targets.expr:
max by(nodename) (
  100 * rate(node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total[$__rate_interval])
  * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by(instance,nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})
)

max by(nodename) (
  100 * rate(node_pressure_io_waiting_seconds_total[$__rate_interval])
  * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by(instance,nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})
)

max by(nodename) (
  100 * rate(node_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total[$__rate_interval])
  * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by(instance,nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})
)

panels.title: OOM kill del kernel sul nodo
panels.description: OOM del kernel (non del cgroup del pod): indica memoria del nodo esaurita.

targets.expr:
max by(nodename) (
  increase(node_vmstat_oom_kill[$__rate_interval])
  * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by(instance,nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})
) > 0
